title: Verify one audit-log entry per add/edit/remove with the correct bold event labels
custom_preconds: 1. You can view the work-order audit log (Work Orders: Create and Edit) and can add/edit/remove adjustments on an open WO.
custom_steps:
1. Add, edit and remove a fee/discount on the work order.
2. Open the work order ⋮ menu and click 'Audit Log' to open the 'Work Order Log'.
3. Read the Event column.
custom_expected:
1. Each add, each edit and each remove records exactly one entry.
2. Fee events read 'Fee added', 'Fee updated', 'Fee removed'.
3. Discount events read 'Discount added', 'Discount updated', 'Discount removed'.
